review_improvement: Uses official benchmark semantics to expose the unresolved workload identity instead of accepting an assumed '4K Time Spy' run, and separates render, desktop and physical display evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: Resolution is not a single field in 3DMark. Standard Time Spy's graphics workload is rendered at 2560x1440, while Time Spy Extreme renders at 3840x2160; either rendered frame can be scaled to the Windows desktop. Thus a 4K monitor screenshot cannot prove 4K rendering, and a 4K render result cannot prove a physical 4K link. The source must choose the layer(s) before score and PASS semantics exist.
